items.stem: A line of best fit for data on hours studied, h, and test score, s, is s = 5h + 60. What test score does the model predict for a student who studies for 4 hours?
items.explanation: s = 5 · 4 + 60 = 80 (C). 64 — прибавили 4 к 60; 69 — прибавили 5 и 4; 84 — прибавили 24.

items.stem: A line of best fit for data on hours studied, h, and test score, s, is s = 5h + 60. Which of the following is the best interpretation of the number 5 in this context?
choices: The predicted increase in score for each additional hour of study
The predicted score of a student who does not study
The number of hours a typical student studies
The highest possible score on the test
items.explanation: 5 — наклон: на сколько баллов растёт прогноз за каждый лишний час (A). Прогноз без подготовки — 60 (B); C и D не следуют из модели.

items.stem: A model predicts the height y, in centimeters, of a plant x weeks after it is planted: y = 2.5x + 4. What height, in centimeters, does the model predict 6 weeks after planting?

A scatterplot shows that on days with higher temperatures, an ice cream stand tends to sell more ice cream. Which of the following best describes the association between temperature and ice cream sales?
items.explanation: Обе величины растут вместе — положительная связь (A). Отрицательная была бы, если бы продажи падали с ростом температуры.

items.stem: A line of best fit has the equation y = −0.8x + 50. What is the predicted value of y when x = 10?
items.explanation: −0.8 · 10 + 50 = 42 (B). 58 — потеряли минус; 49.2 — вычли только 0.8; 30 — вычли 20.

items.stem: A model for a set of data is y = 3x − 2. For what value of x does the model predict y = 25?
A data point is (6, 20). The line of best fit predicts y = 17 when x = 6. What is the residual for this data point? (Residual = actual value − predicted value.)
items.explanation: 20 − 17 = 3 (B): точка на 3 выше прямой. −3 — вычли в обратном порядке; 37 — сложили; 17 — прогноз.

items.stem: A quantity increases by about the same amount each year. Which type of model is most appropriate for the data?
items.explanation: Одинаковый прирост за равные промежутки — линейная модель (A). Экспонента — одинаковый процент роста; квадратичная с максимумом сначала растёт, потом падает.

items.stem: The model C = 0.15m + 2 gives the cost C, in dollars, of a phone call that lasts m minutes. What is the predicted cost, in dollars, of a 40-minute call?
items.explanation: 0.15 · 40 = 6, плюс 2 — 8 долларов.

items.stem: A scatterplot of the ages of used cars and their prices shows that older cars tend to have lower prices. Which of the following best describes the association between age and price?
choices: It cannot be determined from a scatterplot.
items.explanation: Одна величина растёт, другая падает — отрицательная связь (A). Диаграмма рассеяния как раз позволяет это увидеть (D неверно).

items.stem: The line of best fit for a scatterplot passes through the points (0, 12) and (5, 22). What is the slope of the line?
items.explanation: (22 − 12)/(5 − 0) = 2 (A). 10 — изменение y; 5 — изменение x; 12 — пересечение с осью y.

items.stem: The number of visitors V to a new museum d days after it opened is modeled by V = 120 + 15d. How many visitors does the model predict on day 10?
items.explanation: V = 120 + 150 = 270 посетителей.

items.stem: Which of the following data points is farthest vertically from the line y = x?
items.explanation: Вертикальное расстояние |y − x|: 7, 1, 0 и 1. Дальше всех (2, 9) (A); (6, 6) лежит на прямой.

items.stem: A set of data is modeled by y = 40(1.1)^x. What type of relationship does the model describe?
items.explanation: x в показателе — экспонента; основание 1.1 > 1 — рост на 10% за шаг (A). Распад был бы при основании меньше 1.

items.stem: A line of best fit for a data set is y = 1.2x + 3. What is the predicted value of y when x = 15?
The line of best fit for the population y, in thousands, of a town x years after 2010 is y = 2.4x + 85. Which of the following is the best interpretation of 85 in this context?
choices: The estimated population of the town in 2010 was 85,000.
The population increases by about 85,000 each year.
The population in 2085 is predicted to be 2,400.
The population will reach 85,000 in 2.4 years.
items.explanation: 85 — значение при x = 0, то есть в 2010 году, в тысячах: 85 000 (A). Ежегодный прирост — 2.4 тысячи (B неверно); C и D путают переменные.

items.stem: The population y, in thousands, of a town x years after 2010 is modeled by y = 2.4x + 85. In what year does the model predict a population of 121 thousand?
A data set consists of the points (1, 3), (2, 6), (3, 12), and (4, 24). Which of the following equations best models the data?
items.explanation: Каждое следующее y вдвое больше — экспонента с основанием 2; при x = 1: 1.5 · 2 = 3 (A). y = 7x − 4 проходит только через две точки; y = 3x даёт 6, 9, 12; x² + 2 даёт 3, 6, 11, 18.

items.stem: For 10 randomly selected students, a scatterplot of hours of sleep and reaction time shows a strong negative linear association. Which of the following statements is supported by the scatterplot?
choices: Students who slept more tended to have shorter reaction times.
Sleeping more causes a student's reaction time to become shorter.
Students who slept more tended to have longer reaction times.
Hours of sleep and reaction time are unrelated.
items.explanation: Отрицательная связь: больше сна — в среднем меньше время реакции (A). Это наблюдение, а не эксперимент, поэтому о причине (B) говорить нельзя; C описывает положительную связь.

items.stem: The line of best fit for a data set is y = −3.5x + 92. One of the data points is (8, 60). What is the residual for this data point? (Residual = actual value − predicted value.)
items.explanation: Прогноз: −28 + 92 = 64. Остаток 60 − 64 = −4 — точка на 4 ниже прямой.

items.stem: The table shows four pairs of values of x and y. Which equation models the data exactly?
items.explanation: При x = 0 y = 5; при росте x на 2 y растёт на 4, наклон 2: y = 2x + 5 (A). B использует изменение y на шаг 2 как наклон; D сдвигает пересечение.

items.stem: A biologist models a fish population with P = 500(0.88)^t, where t is the number of years since the study began. According to the model, by what percent does the population decrease each year?
items.explanation: Каждый год остаётся 88%, значит уменьшение 12% (C). 88% — оставшаяся доля; 0.88% и 8.8% — неверное чтение множителя.

items.stem: A line of best fit passes through the points (2, 7) and (10, 23). What value of y does the line predict when x = 14?
items.explanation: Наклон (23 − 7)/(10 − 2) = 2, уравнение y = 2x + 3. При x = 14: 31.

items.stem: A data point has a residual of −2 with respect to a line of best fit. Which of the following is true?
choices: The actual value is 2 less than the value predicted by the model.
The actual value is 2 more than the value predicted by the model.
The slope of the line of best fit is −2.
The data point is 2 units to the left of the line.
items.explanation: Остаток = факт − прогноз = −2, то есть факт на 2 меньше прогноза, точка ниже прямой (A). Остаток не связан с наклоном (C) и измеряется по вертикали (D).

items.stem: A model for the distance d, in kilometers, that a cyclist rides in t minutes is d = 0.6t. According to the model, how many minutes does it take the cyclist to ride 18 kilometers?
items.explanation: 0.6t = 18, t = 30 минут (C). 10.8 — умножили 18 на 0.6; 108 — сдвиг запятой; 18.6 — сложили.

items.stem: The line of best fit for data on the price p, in dollars, of a product and the weekly demand q, in units, is q = 900 − 30p. At what price, in dollars, does the model predict a demand of 0 units?
items.explanation: 900 − 30p = 0, p = 30 долларов.

items.stem: Data on the trunk diameters and ages of trees with diameters between 10 and 60 centimeters are modeled by a line of best fit. For which of the following trees would the model's prediction of age be least reliable?
choices: A tree with a diameter of 150 centimeters
A tree with a diameter of 20 centimeters
A tree with a diameter of 45 centimeters
A tree with a diameter of 60 centimeters
items.explanation: 150 см далеко за пределами данных (10–60 см) — это экстраполяция, модель может там не работать (A). Остальные диаметры внутри диапазона.

items.stem: In a scatterplot, the points lie very close to a line with a positive slope. Which of the following best describes the correlation between the two variables?
items.explanation: Точки близко к прямой — связь сильная, наклон положительный — связь положительная (A). Слабая была бы при большом рассеянии.

items.stem: A data set is modeled by the exponential function y = 200(1.5)^x. What value of y does the model predict when x = 2?
The height h, in meters, of a ball t seconds after it is thrown is modeled by h = −4.9t² + 20t + 1.5. According to the model, what is the height of the ball 2 seconds after it is thrown?
items.explanation: −4.9 · 4 + 40 + 1.5 = −19.6 + 41.5 = 21.9 м (B). 41.5 — забыли первое слагаемое; 61.1 — потеряли его знак; 1.5 — начальная высота.

items.stem: The value y, in thousands of dollars, of a car x years after it was bought is modeled by y = 24(0.85)^x. According to the model, what is the value of the car, in thousands of dollars, 3 years after it was bought, rounded to the nearest tenth?
items.explanation: 0.85³ ≈ 0.6141, 24 · 0.6141 ≈ 14.7 (B). 20.4 — значение через один год; 16.3 и 8.7 — ошибки в степени или в множителе.

items.stem: A least-squares line of best fit is found for 6 data points, so the sum of the 6 residuals is 0. The residuals for five of the points are 0.5, −1, 1.5, −0.5, and 0. What is the residual for the sixth point?
items.explanation: Сумма пяти остатков 0.5. Шестой должен её компенсировать: −0.5.

items.stem: An app had 1,000 users when it launched, and the number of users doubled every 6 months. Which function best models the number of users U, t months after launch?
items.explanation: Удвоение раз в 6 месяцев: показатель t/6 увеличивается на 1 каждые 6 месяцев (A). B — линейный рост; C — рост в 6 раз каждые 2 месяца; D — линейная функция.

items.stem: The line of best fit y = 12.5x + 300 was found using data from 2015 to 2023, where x is the number of years since 2015. A student uses the line to predict the value of y in 2050. Why is this prediction unreliable?
choices: 2050 is far outside the range of years used to create the model.
The slope of the line is positive.
The data used for the model begin in 2015.
The y-intercept of the line is too large.
items.explanation: Модель построена по 2015–2023 годам; 2050 — далёкая экстраполяция, тренд может измениться (A). Знак наклона и величина пересечения не делают прогноз ненадёжным сами по себе.

items.stem: The data points (1, 40), (2, 20), (3, 10), and (4, 5) lie exactly on the graph of y = a(b)^x, where a and b are constants. What is the value of a?
items.explanation: y уменьшается вдвое: b = 1/2. a · (1/2) = 40, значит a = 80 (значение при x = 0).

items.stem: Two models predict a town's population t years from now: P(t) = 50,000(1.02)^t and Q(t) = 50,000 + 1,200t. According to the models, which predicts the greater population 10 years from now, and by about how much?
items.explanation: P(10) = 50 000 · 1.02¹⁰ ≈ 60 950, Q(10) = 62 000. Q больше примерно на 1050 (A). 12 000 — это прирост Q, а не разница; экспонента обгонит прямую только позже.

items.stem: The line of best fit for a data set is y = 4.2x − 7. According to the line, if x increases by 5, by how much does the predicted value of y change?
items.explanation: Наклон 4.2 на единицу x, на 5 единиц — 21 (C). 4.2 — на одну единицу; 14 — 21 − 7, свободный член тут ни при чём; 28 — 4.2 · 5 + 7.

items.stem: A line of best fit predicts y = 52 when x = 10 and y = 40 when x = 6. What value of y does the line predict when x = 0?

A scatterplot shows the number of hours of TV watched per week and the grade point average for 200 randomly selected students. The correlation coefficient is −0.65. Which conclusion is best supported?
choices: Students who watched more TV tended to have lower grade point averages.
Watching more TV causes a student's grade point average to decrease.
Every student who watched more TV had a lower grade point average.
There is no association between TV watching and grade point average.
items.explanation: Умеренная отрицательная корреляция — тенденция, а не правило для каждого (C) и не причинность (B): это наблюдение, а не эксперимент. Верно A.

items.stem: A quadratic model for a data set is y = 3x² − 2x + 5. What is the predicted value of y when x = −2?
items.explanation: 3 · 4 + 4 + 5 = 21 (C). 13 — взяли −2x как −4; 17 и 25 — ошибки в квадрате или знаке.

items.stem: A line of best fit for a data set has the equation y = 0.75x + b, where b is a constant. The data point (8, 11) has a residual of 2. What is the value of b?
items.explanation: Остаток 2 значит, что прогноз 11 − 2 = 9. 0.75 · 8 + b = 9, b = 3.

items.stem: Two models for an investment are A(t) = 300(1.04)^t and B(t) = 300(1.04²)^(t/2). Which of the following is true?
choices: B grows twice as fast as A.
B grows half as fast as A.
A and B have different initial values.
items.explanation: (1.04²)^(t/2) = 1.04^(2 · t/2) = 1.04^t — модели совпадают (A). При t = 0 обе дают 300.

items.stem: A scientist models the water temperature T, in degrees Celsius, at a depth of d meters in a lake as T = 22 − 0.4d, for 0 ≤ d ≤ 30. At what depth, in meters, does the model predict a temperature of 14°C?
items.explanation: 22 − 0.4d = 14, 0.4d = 8, d = 20 м (C). 8 — изменение температуры; 36 — сумма 22 + 14; 14 — сама температура.

items.stem: Revenue R is modeled by R = 1,500(1.08)^t, where t is the number of years. By what factor does R increase over 9 years, rounded to the nearest tenth?
items.explanation: 1.08⁹ ≈ 1.999 ≈ 2.0 — выручка примерно удваивается за 9 лет (правило 72: 72/8 = 9).

items.stem: The points (2, 7), (6, 21), and (10, y) all lie on the graph of y = kx, where k is a constant. What is the value of y?
items.explanation: k = 7/2 = 3.5 (проверка: 3.5 · 6 = 21). y = 3.5 · 10 = 35 (B). 30 и 40 — линейное продолжение с другим шагом; 70 — 7 · 10.
